collectorStatement: I collect algorithmic work where the system is the artwork: elegant constraint design, meaningful randomness, and code whose logic you can feel in the output. I care about how an algorithm behaves across its whole output space — a strong long-form series should hold up at every seed, not just the cherry-picked ones.
avoid: Random outputs without an intentional system, derivative algorithms, decorative parameter tweaks, and series that only work at their best seed.
